correctness.rationale: For every odd m≥1 and odd L≥3, the quotient is a degree-L regular labeled graph cover of a bipartite Möbius ladder (or 3-parallel-edge multigraph). For any H-invariant edge orbit selection, matching is equivalent downstairs. Base-extendible implies lifted-extendible; conversely projecting the complement of an upstairs perfect matching yields nonnegative base edge counts with every vertex incident sum L. Hall inequalities give a base perfect matching, and the orbit-barycenter simplicial model is canonically PL. Small sphere-wedge type input is cited, not independently claimed.
